item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 26/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the upper-air disturbance departing, the weather will be brighter over the coast of southern China today. A trough of low pressure will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to Guangdong later on Monday and Tuesday. A strong easterly airstream is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong midweek this week, and a broad trough of low pressure will affect the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of this week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the Philippines is expected to move in the general direction of the seas east of Luzon today and tomorrow.
